channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Weather basics must start with the sun
item.description: To begin understanding how and why we experience weather here on Earth, we need to start at the source of nearly all the energy that drives our atmosphere: the sun.

item.title: Canadian annual inflation rate edges down in January as gasoline costs drop
item.description: Canada’s annual inflation rate in January accelerated at a slower pace than the previous month as a big drop in gasoline prices helped cushion the impact of higher food and clothing prices, Statistics Canada said on Tuesday.

item.title: General Mills cuts annual outlook as shoppers seek cheaper options
item.description: General Mills cut its annual core sales and profit forecasts on Tuesday as the Cheerios cereal maker contends with a volatile economic backdrop and evolving consumer tastes.

item.title: Grain sector urged to rethink royalties on seed
item.description: Farmers and grower groups are angry about AAFC research cuts, but this could be an opportunity to create a better funding model for plant breeding, says seed industry rep

item.title: Gopher options remain slim
item.description: The agricultural sector is disappointed that the Pest Management Regulatory Agency recently denied a request for the emergency use registration of strychnine.

item.title: Canada announces new chief trade negotiator to the United States
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced on Monday the appointment of public servant Janice Charette as the next chief trade negotiator to the United States for the review of the CUSMA trade agreement.

item.title: Open sow housing deadline may prove difficult
item.description: Fifty to 60 per cent of sows on the Prairies are now housed in open systems, says a designer of housing and feeding systems for livestock. Getting the rest across the finish line will be a struggle.

item.title: Young farmers urged to start smart, invest now
item.description: Investing is commonly perceived as something for the future, like retirement, that isn’t at the top of mind for young farmers, but it should be.

item.title: Bayer proposes $7.25 billion plan to settle U.S. Roundup cancer suits
item.description: Bayer said on Tuesday its Monsanto unit had filed a proposed U.S. class settlement totalling as much as $7.25 billion (C$9.89 billion) aimed at resolving all current and future claims that its Roundup weedkiller caused cancer.

item.title: Pulse Weekly: Lentil prices currently lacking direction
item.description: There’s little at the present time to guide cash prices for lentils on the Canadian Prairies, said Marcos Mosnaim of Prairie IX in Toronto.
